summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. Changes: rdflib/namespace.py — Namespace.__contains__(ref) returns ref.startswith(str(self)) (prefix test, reference as tested value); ClosedNamespace.__contains__(ref) returns True only if ref == a stored term URI (node-type-aware, so plain strings and Literals are False; container properties like rdf:_1 are False; _RDFNamespace inherits it); _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). NamespaceManager unchanged; no imports added. test/test_namespace.py — added test_namespace_prefix_membership, test_closed_namespace_membership (RDFS positive/negative, Literal and plain-string negatives, RDF positive, rdf:_1 negative), and test_shacl_namespace_membership; imports updated. Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
